title: Durable media persistence and recovery manager

deliverables.requirement: Move required media durability toward Firebase Storage-backed records, with IndexedDB as queue/cache.
deliverables.evidence: index.html defines MEDIA_POLICY_VERSION, prepareMediaEntryForDurability(), queueMediaForStorage(), processMediaDurabilityQueue(), storage paths under studios/{studioId}/media, and Storage putString upload handling. New audio/video/consent media entry paths now call prepareMediaEntryForDurability().

processMediaDurabilityQueue() returns structured blocked/partial/uploaded states, tracks attempts/lastError for retry, and returns storage-auth-required when Firebase admin auth/storage is unavailable. Browser check verified this blocked degraded state.

deliverables.requirement: Unified load/recovery path for photos/audio/video/consent recordings.
deliverables.evidence: window.vsMediaRecovery.resolve() resolves storageUrl, IndexedDB _mediaKey, or inline data. scanMediaRecovery() scans student/consult photo, audios, videos, and consentRec entries.

scanMediaRecovery() reports summary totals, queuedOrCached, recoveryRequired, unknown, and orphan queue items. markRecoveryRequiredFromScan() annotates unresolved media entries with recoveryRequired/storageStatus/mediaPolicyVersion. Browser check verified unresolved [saved] consent media was annotated.

createMediaRecoverySnapshot(), listMediaRecoverySnapshots(), diffMediaRecoverySnapshots(), exportMediaRecoverySnapshot(), importMediaRecoverySnapshotText(), and markRecoveryRequiredFromScan() were added under window.vsMediaRecovery. Browser check verified snapshot diff detected recoveryRequired -> queued status change.
